publicCallers.contract: Curve::breakpoints returns ordered parameters inside supplied range, endpoints included. Periodic curves permit arbitrary-phase requested intervals, not only canonical0..2pi. Zero width returns two identical endpoints in old implementation and candidate.

exceptionBehavior: New invalid_argument for nonfinite/reversed interval, domain_error for nonprogressive next index. Propagate unless caller explicitly recovers; pcurveDeviation does not convert breakpoint-generation exceptions to+Inf. computePCurves captures job failures and rethrows all before assigning any generated fin. OperationCancelled is a distinct non-std exception and bypasses std::exception geometry recovery.
